name: Cabela's 1,013-Piece Spinner-Making Kit - Chartreuse
description: Our 1,013-Piece Spinner-Maker Kit provides everything you need to catch the attention of fish. Includes 20 #4 and #6 red octopus hooks, 25 #4 and #6 bronze octopus hooks, 10 treble hooks, eight rig floats, four pencil floats, four spin floats, six quick-change clevices, 100 stirrup clevises, 50 4mm and 50 5mm beads in each color (Red, Ruby, Green, Chartreuse, Pearl, Gold, Glow), 45 Colorado and Indiana blades, five #2, 25 #3, 10 #4, five #5 and one organizer box. Color: Chartreuse. Type: Blades.
